records.title: Complete open pull-request inventory and base-SHA reconciliation
records.summary: Two-page complete REST inventory returned 173 open PRs: 163 drafts, 10 ready for review, 171 targeting main and two targeting non-main branches. Current main is b28f43c907517e939e299e8766e2ebe655a0df13. None of the 171 main-based PRs has base.sha equal to current main; all 171 are stale. The latest PRs #1397 and #1398 target base 33a490e, one commit behind main. No bulk rebase, merge or force-push was performed.
records.methodology: GitHub REST pulls endpoint with state=open, per_page=100, page=1 and page=2; exact base.sha compared against the main branch ref fetched in the same audit.
records.limitations: Inventory is a point-in-time count at 07:15 UTC. Open/closed state and base SHAs can change. The two non-main PRs are excluded from the main-base staleness calculation. Stale does not mean conflicting; exact changed-path and merge-base review remains necessary.

records.title: Exact-head validation of the 352-shard XRP archive and fail-closed gate
records.summary: Exact-head push validation run 41179965992 passed on metadata successor 6ac166956a78f153c6900c1cf010839ccc1ef15a. It checked 352 referenced archive shards, reconciled 1,916 sources, 331 run updates and 832 limitations, matched snapshot blob SHA 90c07097ece598a4aedd8840d01c02b9fa8ba7c3, reported no errors or state mutation, and passed 20 regression tests. Pull-request validator run 41179968168 also passed. Fail-closed gate 41179968039 passed with merging disabled.
records.methodology: GitHub Actions run metadata, job logs and fail-closed gate job result.
records.limitations: This validates the 352-shard data/index head 6ac1669. Any subsequent archive or index mutation requires a new exact-head validation. The validation does not imply PR #1353 is safe to merge into main.
